visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young toddler girl, styled with two small pigtails atop her head, is seen walking steadily along a narrow, light-gray concrete walkway within an enclosed greenhouse. She is dressed in a cream-colored t-shirt adorned with giraffe and leaf illustrations, paired with baggy white trousers. In her right hand, she carries a small red plastic shopping basket, which is currently empty as she looks around the environment with a neutral expression. (2) The camera follows the girl as she enters a section of the greenhouse with elevated planting rows on either side. The lighting is bright and natural, casting soft shadows. She stops briefly and looks directly toward the camera. A hand belonging to an adult, wearing a black smartwatch, enters from the left edge of the frame to gently touch or guide her, though she maintains her independent stance. (3) The shot transitions to a close-up of the red plastic basket placed on the concrete floor, now containing several ripe, red strawberries alongside a pair of small blue-handled scissors. The video then cuts back to the girl walking on the path, now holding a bright red strawberry in each hand. Her facial expression is one of pure focus and growing excitement as she moves toward the camera. (4) The scene shifts to an outdoor, shaded dining area with blue plastic stools and various clutter including a stroller and green barrels. The young girl is seated on one of the stools, holding a large strawberry close to her mouth. Another young girl in a brown shirt is briefly visible sitting nearby, also eating fruit. The background shows a busy public farm or market setting with muted colors and natural lighting. (5) This phase features several tight close-up shots of the young girl's face as she interacts with someone off-camera. She takes a deliberate bite of a large strawberry, her cheeks puffing out as she chews. Her eyes are wide and expressive. A hand reaches into the shot, and the girl places her tiny hand onto the palm in a "handshake" gesture, smiling slightly. (6) The final scene is a static, graphic animation against a solid pink background. A small, stylized cartoon character of the girl is centered above the white capitalized text "POPO'S DAILY LIFE."

All ambient noise and vocal tracks are cut, leaving only the final, resonant notes of the jingle to accompany the outro graphic.
